what: On a background-colored panel, the number beside the big logo counts from 1 to 100 over 2s power3.inOut. When it finishes, the panel waits 1.5s and then turns transparent over 2.5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), revealing the Hero photo underneath. Meanwhile the logo changes to the on-photo text color over 2.5s power4.out and stays over the photo, then after a 2s hold it blurs out over 1s power2.out while moving 100px up. The number slides up .5s later over .5s. When done, it releases the document lock and fires fx:done.

options.wait: Pause (seconds) after counting finishes before the logo color changes, default 1.5 — panel fade delay is --fx-wait in css
options.tint: Duration of the logo color change (seconds), default 2.5 — the panel transparency duration is --fx-fade in css
options.stay: Time held on the photo (sec), default 2
options.lock: If false, the document is not locked — default is scroll lock until the end
options.[data-fx-part=logo]: Large logo (svg or text drawn in currentColor)
options.--fx-melt: Color the logo changes to (css), default --kf-contrast-ink
options.fx:done: Fired from the element when all done (bubbles) — hook the Hero slider and entrance here

note: For screens opened often like an app, reduce count, wait and stay — the original totals about 9 seconds.
